verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is an open-source, self-hostable CLI tool that runs entirely offline as a static binary with no server, account, or telemetry requirement (gitleaks-probe-5), installable via Homebrew/Docker/Go (gitleaks-gh-8) and verified working via a hands-on scan (gitleaks-probe-4). missing for 10: no first-party self-hosted 'server' or SaaS deployment guide beyond CLI/CI usage, and no independent enterprise self-hosting case study.
